meta.name: theme-factory
meta.description: Toolkit for styling artifacts with a theme. These artifacts can be slides, docs, reportings, HTML landing pages, etc. There are 10 pre-set themes with colors/fonts that you can apply to any artifact that has been creating, or can generate a new theme on-the-fly.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为幻灯片、文档等作品一键套用或生成主题样式
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要为不同文档或演示统一配色和字体风格
copy.tagline_en: Apply or generate themes for slides, docs, and more
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need consistent colors and fonts across documents and presentations

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会给幻灯片、文档、报告、HTML 落地页等作品应用配色与字体主题。内置 10 套主题可选择,也可按描述现场生成新主题。
howto.when: 当你要求给幻灯片、文档等作品套用配色与字体,或现有主题不适用需要生成新主题时触发。

say.text: 给这套幻灯片用 Ocean Depths 主题。
say.note: 会应用该主题的配色和字体。

say.text: 帮我生成一个复古报纸风格的新主题。
say.note: 会先生成主题供你确认再应用。

say.text: 给报告换成 Modern Minimalist 主题。
say.note: 会按该主题调整颜色和字体。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can apply a color-and-font theme to artifacts such as slides, documents, reports, and HTML landing pages. It offers 10 preset themes and can generate a new theme on the fly based on a description.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to restyle a slide deck or other artifact with colors and fonts, or when no existing theme fits and a custom theme should be generated.

say_en.text: Apply Ocean Depths to this slide deck.
say_en.note: Uses the preset theme for colors and fonts.

say_en.text: Create a new vintage-newspaper style theme.
say_en.note: Generates a theme and shows it for approval first.

say_en.text: Switch this report to Modern Minimalist.
say_en.note: Applies that theme's colors and fonts.
